text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day before the Arima Kinen, Matikanefukukitaru visits a shrine to pray.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, having realized that victory is something she must claim on her own, she finds herself with nothing to pray for anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rather than asking for something, she stands before the gods and vows to win the Arima Kinen.
